*Grants players a {{KeyItem}}[[Shiny Ra'Kaznarian plate]] when they have met the [[Sortie]] prerequisites.
*Grants players {{KeyItem}}[[Ruspix's plate]] after they have entered [[Sortie]] at least once to start banking up to 20 hours before their dulled plates are restored.
*Reminds players of which temporary items they have access to inside of Sortie.
*Charges 10,000 [[Gallimaufry]] and 1 [[Ra'Kaznar Sapphire]] to [[Reforged Empyrean Armor +2|upgrade reforged Empyrean Armor to +2]].
*Charges 70,000 [[Gallimaufry]] and 1 [[Ra'Kaznar Starstone]] to [[Reforged Empyrean Armor +3|upgrade reforged Empyrean Armor to +3]].
*Sells:
**[[Ra'Kaznar Sapphire]]: 15,000 gallimaufry.
**[[Ra'Kaznar Starstone]]: 90,000 gallimaufry. Must enter any of Areas E, F, G, or H in [[Sortie]] first.
**[[Old Case]]: 80,000 gallimaufry.
| historicalbackground = 
}}
==Bugs==
*Trading Ruspix a [[Ra'Kaznar Sapphire]] without also trading a piece of [[Reforged Empyrean Armor +1]] will still consume the sapphire and take your 10,000 gallimaufry.<ref>[https://www.ffxiah.com/forum/topic/56855/sortie-release-info/36/#3637290 Yvan, FFXIAH Forum]</ref> '''Fixed on August 25, 2022.'''<ref>[http://www.playonline.com/ff11us/polnews/news26790.shtml POL NA]</ref>
